Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “the performer” of “Down Ass Bitch” as the featured artist (Charli Baltimore) instead of the main artist (Ja Rule). The performer of the song is Ja Rule, whose birthplace is Queens, New York. This wrong assumption led the workflow to look up Charli Baltimore’s birthplace (Philadelphia) and thus arrive at the wrong solution. Additionally, the Planner incorrectly associated Charli Baltimore’s real name with Kimberly Denise Jones (Lil’ Kim) rather than Tiffany Lane, compounding the error.
